How to Apply
The Ph.D. Program in Chemistry at Rice University combines world-class research with personalized mentorship to train the next generation of scientific innovators. With a low student-to-faculty (3:1) ratio, our students work at the forefront of discovery alongside leading faculty, tackling fundamental and applied challenges in chemistry, materials science, energy, sustainability, and human health. A collaborative culture, exceptional access to faculty and research resources, and strong partnerships across Rice, the Texas Medical Center, and industry create an environment where students can pursue ambitious ideas and make meaningful scientific impact. Through rigorous research training, professional development opportunities, and a supportive community, Rice Ph.D. students graduate prepared to lead across academia, industry, and the broader scientific enterprise.
